# Awesome Kotlin dApp

> Created and curated by CodesbyFebin. Kotlin dApp resource catalog and source-workspace bootstrap; not a finished or certified application.

## Entry points
- [README](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/awesome-kotlin-dapp/blob/main/README.md): categorized resources and qualification boundaries.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/awesome-kotlin-dapp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): source, security and evidence policy.
- [Build prompt](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/awesome-kotlin-dapp/blob/main/docs/MASTER-BUILD-PROMPT.md): end-to-end implementation gates.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/awesome-kotlin-dapp/blob/main/docs/AGENT-QUICKSTART.md): clone and source-fetch commands.
- [Catalog](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/awesome-kotlin-dapp/blob/main/catalog/resources.json): verified repository metadata and commit pins.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/awesome-kotlin-dapp/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): platform and readiness boundaries.
- [Credits](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/awesome-kotlin-dapp/blob/main/CREDITS.md): upstream ownership.

## Constraints
Kotlin clients are distinct from on-chain programs. Wallet keys stay with wallets. No build, audit, device or production PASS is implied by inclusion. Archived and privileged-platform resources are optional references.
